question: In the CFD model of the shell-and-tube heat exchanger with Al2O3/water nanofluid, what inlet temperature was set for the shell-side fluid, and at what temperature were the tube walls held?
expect: inlet 27 °C (mass flow inlet); tube walls 177 °C (sec. 2.2.4 boundary conditions)
rendered:
Heat Transfer Enhancement in a Shell-and-Tube Type of Heat Exchanger Using Al2O3/Water Nanofluid, page 4

The inlet mass flow rate, inlet temperature, and wall temperature were maintained constant, with no transient thermal or hydrodynamic disturbances imposed on the system. 

The inlet temperature of the shell-side fluid was set at 27 °C. 
The tube walls were held at a uniform temperature of 177 °C.
